briefing.text: Information Technology still leads attention on News (buzz 86.5, -1.9 on the day, -1.0 over the week; NVDA, AMD, MSFT, HPE, MU), on X (93.7, +0.3, mentions +17%) and on Reddit (94.1, -1.1, mentions -42%). Health Care is the main riser: News buzz 86.1 (+2.7 day, +2.9 week, mentions +59%, sentiment 0.35; INSM, SNY, MDT, MRNA, REGN), and on X it moved up from #6 to #4 (buzz 91.0, +1.5). Consumer Discretionary rose from #6 to #3 on News (buzz 84.9, +2.2, mentions +53%; AMZN, TSLA, DKS, ANF, BBY). Energy (News buzz 77.1, -2.0, mentions -25%) and Utilities (75.0, -2.4, mentions -11%) fell back.

DLTR #1: results lifted the stock about 12% on Tuesday despite a margin slip, with 92 articles in 2 days (69 positive, 1 negative); this explains the ranking.
MDT #2: headlines are mostly generic takeaways and ETF holdings notes, with mixed tone (12 positive, 10 negative of 42); the news does not clearly explain the jump from #7.
BBY #3: first earnings report under new CEO Jason Bonfig, 57 articles (36 positive, 0 negative); explains the rank.
DG #4: sympathy move after Dollar Tree's results lifted discounters; 13 articles, 10 positive; explains the rank, with earnings due 12-03.
SILVER #6: little news (2 articles); headlines say silver miners fell on rate-hike concerns and the trust is down 65% from its high, so the price move, not news, drives it.
ZM #9: 37 articles, mixed tone (16 positive, 11 negative); a new Asia head and generic takeaways, nothing that explains the rank.
COIN #11: 38 articles, mixed (6 positive, 8 negative); an analyst initiation and Coinbase's CEO on weak new listings; partly explains the jump from #324.
MU #15: a BNP Paribas downgrade with a 54% price target cut (145 articles, 63 negative) and a falling stock explain the rank.

DLTR (#1, score 0.981) leads on attention: 3.7x normal on the news/Reddit measure and 4.1x on X, plus a 3.1-sigma price move (+11% in 24h) after earnings. Volume is only 1.2x normal and open interest is near normal. MDT (#2, 0.932, up from #7) has attention 1.8x and X attention 1.9x normal, a 2.5-sigma move (-4.6%) and a KPI-market catalyst, while open interest is below normal. BBY (#3, 0.922) has attention 2.8x and X attention 3.0x normal, a KPI-market catalyst, and a small move (0.9 sigma) with volume just under normal.
